about_page.hero_subtitle: TheWorkingZone bridges skilled workers, contractors, and site owners directly with transparency, dignity, and real-time execution clarity.
about_page.pillar1_desc: Eliminating exploitation by connecting workers directly to verified job postings and direct contractor agreements.
about_page.pillar2_desc: Geographical precision ensures workers find daily site work close to home, reducing commute time and travel expenses.
about_page.pillar3_desc: Digital work logs and clear unit economics ensure every hour worked is accounted for and paid reliably.
about_page.pillar4_desc: Empowering India's blue-collar sector with digital identity, verified skills, and sustainable financial growth.
about_page.impact_desc: Built specifically for real-world site conditions, field contractors, and hard-working individuals.
about_page.impact1_desc: Clear operational boundaries between companies, contractors, and site workers.
about_page.impact2_desc: Deploy labor pools in under 60 seconds with location-aware dispatching.
about_page.impact3_desc: Ratings and verified experience records build a permanent digital worker CV.

vision_page.hero_title: Building the Operational Backbone for Blue-Collar India
vision_page.hero_subtitle: Ensuring every worker is valued, every contractor is empowered, and every project gets reliable manpower.
vision_page.pillar1_desc: Creating structured workflows where every stakeholder understands their responsibilities, site tasks, and compensation.
vision_page.pillar2_desc: Enabling digital attendance, daily wage tracking, and transparent unit economics to foster economic dignity.
vision_page.pillar3_desc: Designed to scale effortlessly from local municipal sites to multi-state infrastructure mega-projects.
vision_page.pillar4_desc: Integrating site safety standards, verified worker identification, and compliance into daily site workflows.
vision_page.phase1_desc: Establishing verified contractor networks and worker skill pools across primary urban centers.
vision_page.phase2_desc: Rolling out regional language support, multi-site attendance tools, and automated labor dispatch.
vision_page.phase3_desc: Providing financial growth tools, skill certifications, and long-term economic security for every worker.
vision_page.spotlight_desc: Transforming unorganized labor into a digitally empowered, skilled, and dignified national workforce.

features_page.hero_title: Engineered for Site Realities & Real-World Manpower

features_page.f4_desc: Digital worker cards with verified skill badges, work history, and rating records.
features_page.f5_desc: Track labor presence across multiple construction sites and industrial zones in real-time.
features_page.f6_desc: Two-way rating system builds trust between contractors and skilled workers over time.
